verdict.rationale: Post-Incident Reviews pull from the incident lifecycle, Slack data and the Scribe Agent to build chronological incident narratives, so alerts, actions and chat decisions are captured automatically. The Scribe Agent transcribes incident calls and records key decisions and action items, and PIRs can be started from the incident page or Slack after resolution. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of editing or annotating the timeline afterwards (only implied by the PIR workflow), detail on the native incident timeline/log itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
